title: Koko eating bananas
statementMd:
Piles of bananas must be eaten within `hours` (at least `len(piles)`). Each hour you pick one pile and eat up to `k` bananas from it. Return the minimum integer `k`.

**Example:** `min_eating_speed([3, 6, 7, 11], 8)` returns `4`.
hints: Binary search `k` between 1 and the largest pile.
